result.title: State-Isolated Vision Mamba via Update-Tendency Routing for Underwater Image Enhancement
result.summary: Vision Mamba has recently emerged as an efficient alternative to convolutional and Transformer-based architectures by modeling long-range spatial dependencies through recurrent state evolution. Existing studies primarily improve token serialization, scanning strategies, or expert routing, yet largely overlook a state level question question: how should recurrent states be organized for spatially heterogeneous visual restoration? In this paper, we show that forcing tokens with heterogeneous update behaviors to recurrently modify a shared hidden state leads to persistent cross-content interference, which we term \textbf{State Contention}. We further argue that effective recurrent modeling should organize state evolution according to token compatibility rather than token ordering. Based on this observation, we introduce \textbf{State Isolation}, a new recurrent state organization principle for Vision Mamba,tokens with compatible state-update tendencies evolve within independent recurrent state streams. To instantiate this principle, we propose \textbf{IsoMamba}, a $Δ$-guided architecture that constructs model-intrinsic update representations, discovers update-compatible token groups through label-free clustering, and routes them to isolated Mamba experts following a \textbf{cluster--route--isolate} paradigm. In addition, we develop a dynamic channel-wise reweighting objective to compensate for wavelength-dependent reconstruction difficulty in underwater images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IsoMamba consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple underwater image enhancement benchmarks while providing cleaner hidden state responses, validating the effectiveness of state isolated recurrent modeling.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 Vision Mamba 提出 State Isolation 原则与 IsoMamba：指出更新行为异构的 token 共享同一循环隐状态会造成「State Contention」干扰，因而用 Δ 引导的表示与无标签聚类，把相容 token 路由到相互隔离的循环状态流，用于水下图像增强。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按状态更新倾向对 token 分组、并用隔离的循环状态流避免共享隐状态相互干扰」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态污染、信息坍缩与多流状态路由等具体问题。
